d: This is the true story of the kidnapping of Amber Hagerman and how her family came together to help other abducted children as a result of her tragedy  which resulted in a new system to help find missing children - The Amber Alert.
A troubled youth vandalizes a church and winds up in a close association with the woodcarver whose work he destroyed.
A British exchange student upends her host family's life when she tries to take the place of their daughter.
Vicki is forced to repeat the same day over and over as she searches for an antiquity: Pandora's Box.
Coreen leads a case that takes them to an insect demon who is using local Goth kids to feed her swarm.
